paite: Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, himhim nei in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na kithoih ding uh ahi kei. Hiai lah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ngal a.
Na lak uah TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na tenna koipeuh uah leng pasal hiam, numei hiam leng, thukhun bohsia a pathian dang nna va sem a,
ka thupiak louh, ni hiam, kha hiam, van ate himhim hiam, TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih a-om a;
ahon hilh ua, nang na zak a, phatuamngaitak a na dot a, ngai in, adik a, thu atel mahmah a, huchibang thilkihhuai Israelte lak a hih ana hihleh;
huai thil gilou hihmi, pasal hiam, numei hiam na kulh kongkhak polam uah pasal hiam numei hiam pen na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uhi.
Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam a pan in asi ding mi hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia kam a pan in hihlup ding ahi kei.
Hihlup ding pen tung ah theihpihte'n akhut uh that ding in akha masa ding ua, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in, huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Sisan kisuah thu ah, sum-le-pai thu ah, kivuak thu ah, na tenna ua kiselna thu himhim a nou a dia vaihawm haksa lua ahong omleh, TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah na hoh ding ua,
huai hun a siampu Levite leh vaihawmte kiang a hoh in na dong ding uhi. Amau thu hihpukdan ding hon na kawkmuh ding uhi.
Huchi in nou TOUPA'N mun aseh ding a pan thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh bang un na hih ding ua, ahon sinsak bang un pilvangtak in na hih ding uhi.
Thu hihpukdan hon na sinsak uleh vaihawmdan hon na hilh bang zel un na hih ding uhi. Thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh uh taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pialsan ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a nasem a pang siampu leh vaihawmmi thu pom lou a, engtat peuhmah, huai mi hihlup ding ahi. Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
Huchi in mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, a-engtat nawn kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gam na va tun ua, na va luah ua, na va ten ua, "I gam a nam tengteng bang in kumpipa i nei ding uh, na chih chiang un,"
heading: Kumpipa Toh Kisai Thuhilhnate

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un atel pen kumpipa dia na neih ding uh ahi. Na unau lak ua mi khat na kumpipa ding ua na bawl ding uh ahi. Namdangmi, na unau uh hilou zaw nou hon uk dia na bawl ding uh ahi kei.

Himahleh sakol tampi akaikhawm ding ahi kei, ahihkeileh sakol zong ding in Aigupta gam a kik nawn ding in mite asawl ding ahi kei. Aziak ahihleh TOUPA'N, "Huai lam a na kik nawn louh ding uh ahi," achi khinta hi.
Alungtang pimang a a-omlouhna ding in zi leng tampi aneih ding ahi kei. Dangka leh dangka-eng leng tampi akhawm ding ahi kei.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, alalgam laltutphah a atut chiang in siampu Levite a pan kila hiai dan teisawn a, amah a dia laibuzial a agelh ding ahi.
Hiai dan amah kiang ah a-om gige ding a, adamsung teng a, asim zel ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA a Pathian laudan asin thei dia, hiai dan thu tengteng leh dan thusehte pilvangtak in azui thei dia,
a-unaute tung ah alungtang akisathei kei dia, dan a pan taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah apial kei ding hi. Huai nung in alalgam Israel tung ah amah leh asuante'n sawtpi vai ahawm ding uhi.
